bias.en: Downtrend · lost $835–869, at the Nov 5 low
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $835–869，位于 11月5日低点

read.en: Sandisk fell 8.6% on Nov 16 to $809.11, trading $799.00–838.48. It is below the 5-day ($893.9), 10-day ($916.1), 30-day ($1,230.3), 100-day ($1,486.5) and 200-day ($1,283.6); all but the 200-day are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,111.12), and RSI is 31.3.

The drop broke the $835–869 supports (Nov 13 low, Nov 6 and 10 closes), now resistance; the $799 low undercut the Nov 5 low ($803.97) before the close recovered above the Nov 5 close. Resistance is $816.4–838.5, then $848.5–860 (Nov 13 low, Nov 10 close) and $885–894 (Nov 13 close, 5-day). Support is $799–806.4, then $750. A close above $838.5 would target $848.5–860; below $799, $750.
